## Diseño experimental

$$\Y_{ij} = \mu + \tau_i + \beta_j + e_ij$$

# Cargar paquetes
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(googlesheets4)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(multcompView)
library(knitr)
```


#Base de datos
>https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_5Ue3HsDQekTM2Whni85ToqJvLOUefV1tcV1Xlso5CU/edit?gid=0#gid=0

# Importar datos
```{r}
# Si tu hoja es pública, descomenta la siguiente línea:
# gs4_deauth()

url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_5Ue3HsDQekTM2Whni85ToqJvLOUefV1tcV1Xlso5CU/edit?gid=0#gid=0"
gs  <- as_sheets_id(url)

fb <- range_read(gs, "fb") |>
  mutate(across(c(trt, bloque), as.factor))

str(fb)
```

# Análisis para longr_3

# ANOVA (BCA)
```{r}
md <- aov(longr_3 ~ trt * sustrato, data = fb)
anova(md)
```

# Comparación de medias (Tukey) con letras
```{r}
emm_int <- emmeans(md, ~ trt)

cld_int <- cld(
  emm_int,
  adjust = "tukey",
  Letters = letters,
  alpha   = 0.05
) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(`.group` = stringr::str_trim(`.group`)) # limpia espacios

kable(cld_int, caption = "longr_3 — Emmeans ± letras de Tukey (α = 0.05)")
```

# Tabla y gráfico final

```{r}
library(dplyr)

df_mean2 <- fb %>%
  group_by(trt, sustrato) %>%     
  summarise(mean_longr3 = mean(longr_3, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(df_mean2, aes(x = trt, y = mean_longr3, fill = sustrato)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge()) +
  labs(
    x = "Tratamientos (trt)",
    y = "Media de longr_3",
    fill = "Sustrato",
    title = "Media de longr_3 por tratamiento y sustrato"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 14))

```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = trt, y = mean_longr3, fill = sustrato)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = groups),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Tratamiento",
    y = "Media de longr_3",
    fill = "Sustrato",
    title = "Media de longr_3 por tratamiento y sustrato (con letras Tukey)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

##############
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(agricolae)

# 1. Tabla de medias por tratamiento y sustrato
df_mean2 <- fb %>%
  group_by(trt, sustrato) %>%
  summarise(mean_longr3 = mean(longr_3, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# 2. ANOVA (solo por tratamiento, porque Tukey evalúa trt)
modelo <- aov(longr_3 ~ trt, data = fb)

# 3. Tukey para tratamiento
tukey <- HSD.test(modelo, "trt", group = TRUE)

# 4. Crear tabla de letras
tabla_letras <- tukey$groups
tabla_letras$trt <- rownames(tabla_letras)

# Asegurar tipos de datos iguales
tabla_letras$trt <- as.factor(tabla_letras$trt)
df_mean2$trt <- as.factor(df_mean2$trt)

# 5. Unir medias con letras de Tukey
df_plot <- merge(df_mean2, tabla_letras, by = "trt")

# 6. Gráfico final con barras + letras ANOVA
ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = trt, y = mean_longr3, fill = sustrato)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = groups),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Tratamientos (trt)",
    y = "Media de longr_3",
    fill = "Sustrato",
    title = "Media de longr_3 por tratamiento y sustrato\nCon letras de significancia (Tukey HSD)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 14))

```
